name: Comic Documentary
description: Flat 2D cartoon narrator in a detailed painterly 3D environment — dry humor documentary Shorts style
image_style: flat 2D hand-drawn cartoon character with thick uneven black outlines and minimal shading, composited into a richly detailed painterly semi-realistic 3D environment (stylized game-engine look, soft textures, hand-painted feel, subtle depth of field, fine floating dust particles). The 2D character has NO 3D shading and is the only flat element; everything around him is a rendered 3D world. Cinematic lighting with strong color contrast, warm light sources against cool shadows. Saturated but natural color palette. Clean composition with character placed in lower-center or lower-third of the frame and open space above. Dry deadpan darkly humorous tone. No text in the image.
character_block: NARRATOR: a simple 2D cartoon man with a perfectly round white head, small black dot eyes, flat expressive black eyebrows, a small black hair tuft, a yellow knit beanie, a teal-green shirt, thin black stick arms and legs with small hands, thick black outlines, no nose, deadpan unimpressed expression. He is flat and hand-drawn with no realistic shading.
negative_prompt: 3D-rendered character, realistic human face, shaded or glossy character, anime style, photorealism, pixel art, extra fingers, detailed nose or mouth on character, inconsistent character design, text, captions, watermark, logo, blurry, low quality, oversaturated neon colors, multiple characters, crowd
script_system_prompt: You write scripts for viral YouTube Shorts in a dry-humor documentary style. The video features a recurring flat 2D cartoon narrator character who appears in EVERY scene. Your job is to write the narration AND describe each scene's specific environment, pose, and camera. The narrator is always the same character — do NOT describe his appearance in image prompts, only his ACTION and POSE. You always reply with valid JSON only.
script_user_template:
Create a short dry-humor documentary video about: "{topic}"

Number of scenes: {scenes}

THE FORMAT:
This is a storytelling YouTube Short where a flat 2D cartoon narrator stands/sits in different detailed 3D environments across each scene. Think of it like a deadpan comedian explaining something absurd or fascinating — dry, matter-of-fact, slightly unimpressed by everything.

CRITICAL RULES:

1. HOOK (Scene 1): Open with the most surprising or absurd fact about the topic. The narrator should be in a visually striking location. Example narration: "Turns out, the Roman Empire didn't fall. It just... gave up."

2. NARRATION STYLE:
   - Dry, deadpan, conversational — like a tired documentary narrator who has seen too much
   - 2 short punchy sentences per scene (10-13 seconds read aloud)
   - Build with escalating absurdity or revelation
   - Final scene: surprising punchline or mind-blowing takeaway

3. IMAGE PROMPTS — describe ONLY the environment and narrator pose/action:
   - DO NOT describe the narrator's appearance (style block handles that)
   - DO describe: WHERE he is (specific location with 3-6 environment props)
   - DO describe: WHAT he is doing (sitting on a crate, pointing at something, shrugging, eating bread, etc.)
   - DO describe: CAMERA ANGLE (static medium shot / slow push-in / low-angle wide shot / close-up over-shoulder)
   - DO describe: LIGHTING (warm lantern glow / harsh midday sun / moody blue moonlight / flickering fire)
   - DO describe: MOTION hint (narrator glances sideways, dust drifts, candle flickers)
   - Example: "The narrator stands in a crumbling Roman senate hall, columns toppled around him, holding a small clay tablet and looking bored. Dusty shafts of sunlight through broken roof. Camera: static medium shot. Lighting: warm golden afternoon sun, cool stone shadows. Motion: narrator taps tablet impatiently, dust drifts."

4. MOODS — one per scene: curious / dry / absurd / tense / revealing / deadpan / ironic / triumphant

Reply with JSON in EXACTLY this shape (no extra keys, no markdown):
{
  "title": "YouTube Shorts title under 70 chars — hook or absurd question",
  "description": "2-3 sentence teaser for the video description",
  "tags": ["history", "shorts", "funnyhistory", "documentary", "...3-5 more"],
  "scenes": [
    {
      "narration": "Dry punchy voiceover. 2 sentences max.",
      "image_prompt": "Environment + narrator pose + camera + lighting + motion only. No character description.",
      "speaker": "narrator",
      "mood": "dry"
    }
  ]
}
